studies.title: Synthetic export-entry comprehension check
studies.question: Do target users understand the export entry without assistance?
studies.sample_frame: Six synthetic participants; no population claim.

evidence.note: Illustrative observation, not a measured result.

claims.statement: The entry label may not match the participant's mental model.
claims.boundary: One synthetic observation cannot establish prevalence.

claims.statement: The available comparison is too small to claim a population effect.
claims.boundary: Applies to this synthetic fixture only.

decisions.recommendation: Revise the label and run a small authorized comprehension check before a broader study.
decisions.reversal_condition: An authorized target-user check shows the current label is discovered and understood without assistance.
decisions.authorization_boundary: This record grants no launch or implementation approval.
